name: Amnext
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The old BNB Chain DeFi protocol Amnext (AMC), a no-loss lottery/prize-pool product, was exploited. The attacker mass-minted Ticket AMC and drained about 154.02 WBNB from the protocol via PancakeSwap, causing a loss of approximately $ 116,100.
